kite.name: Kite General's Watch
kite.line: Patience, vigilance, and a calculated strike awaits.

tiger.name: Tiger General's Watch
tiger.line: We secure the East Ford first, then hold it until the end.

rhino.name: Rhino's Steadfast Defense
rhino.line: We hold the west and middle fords. Let no enemy cross our line.

orchid.name: Orchid's Quiet Might
orchid.line: Hold the banks, watch the riders. Patience is our shield.
